name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited
remarksWeb: During the quarter ended 30 September 2026 the Company successfully completed a Qualified Institutions Placement  raising Rs.1,613.97 crore through the allotment of equity shares to eligible Qualified Institutional Buyers. Following the QIP allotment the Promoters shareholding reduced further to 74.03% and the public shareholding increased to 25.97%. The Company is thereby in full compliance with the Minimum Public Shareholding requirement under Rule 19A of the Securities Contracts Regulation Rules 1957 read with Regulation 38 of the SEBI LODR Regulations 2015.

name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited
shareholdingPatternNotes: The shareholding of SBO Rakesh Shah through GSEC Limited reduced from 35.11% to 32.67% on 29 May 2024 and further reduced to 29,68% on 6 June 2025 and further reduced to 26.15% on 28 July 2026 on account of allotment through QIP

name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited
publicShareholdingNotes: This is to bring to kind notice that the company is currently non- compliant with the Minimum Public Shareholding (MPS) requirement as prescribed under Rule 19A of the SCRR, 1957. The company is taking appropriate measures to restore the public shareholding and any further action in the aforesaid matter shall be disclosed to exchanges. The Company shall be adopting any of the methods as specified in the SEBI Circular dated 03.02.2023 in order to achieve compliance with the MPS requirements.

name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited
revisionRemark: Revision - The Company was in CIRP and the National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad bench has issued the approval order dated 20th June, 2022. The change of management took place on 17th September, 2022. We have received Listing Approval for Reduction of shares on 13th September, 2023. The permission under Reclassification of promoters is exempted under SEBI Reg 9 of 31A of SEBI (LODR)2014 and exemption application filing is still pending. Therefore, the Ex-promoters are not yet reclassified into public category and the new promoters are considered for the purpose of SHP.    Clause 3.7 of Resolution plan states that -   The Existing share capital of the company will be extinguished to the extent of 99%. Post extinguishment of shareholding, Public holding will be thus 5.12 % of the New capital of 5,26,97,106 nos. of shares of Rs 10 each. The necessary corporate actions for the same will be carried out with NSDL or CDSL by the Corporate Debtor. Any fraction shall get rounding off to the nearest number. Shareholders holding less than 100 shares will not be entitled to get any shares and their shares will be extinguished if full. The existing holding of old promoters has also been reduced to 99% and effect of the same has been given in shareholding pattern.

name: Diamond Power Infrastructure Limited
remarksWeb: The Company in its Board meeting held on 17th September, 2022, approved the Reduction of Share Capital and Fresh issue of Shares as mentioned below, in consonance with the NCLT order NCLT Order IA No. 160 of 2022 in CP (IB) 137 of 2018 dated 20/06/2022 and Approved Resolution plan         The paid up share capital of the Company is reduced and extinguished to the extent of 99%.           The Company has issued and allotted 5,00,00,000 (Five Crore only) EquityShares of Rs. 10 each at PAR, aggregating to Rs. 50 Crores, to theSuccessful Resolution Applicant (GSEC Limited in consortium with ShriRakeshRamanlal Shah),and / or their Affiliates or Nominees. Thus the Paid up share Capital, with effect from 17th September, 2022, post reduction and post issue of shares, shall stand at 5,26,97,106 (five crore twenty six lakhs ninety seven thousand onehundred and six) equity shares of Rs 10/- (Rupees ten) each aggregating to Rs 52,69,71,060/-.  The Company has made application on BSE for listing of Both Reduction and Fresh issue of Shares, Which is yet to be approved by BSE. The Company is in the process of making application to NSE.         Thus, the Shareholding Pattern is being filed only on the basis of data as provided by RTA (without providing effect to Reduction as well as Issue of shares to Resolution applicant which is yet to be listed)for the Quarter ended 30th September, 2022.
revisionRemark: The Company was in CIRP and change of management took place on 17th September, 2022. The Existing share capital of the company will be extinguished to the extent of 99%. In reference to the NCLT Order as mentioned above and resolution plan as approved by NCLT, the Board of Directors in their meeting held on 17th September, 2022 have approved, the issue and allotment of 5,00,00,000(Five Crore) New Equity Shares of Rs 10/- (Rupees ten) each, to the Successful Resolution Applicant (GSEC Limited in consortium with Shri Rakesh Ramanlal Shah) and / or their Affiliates or Nominees in terms of the approved resolution plan by Honorable NCLT, Ahmedabad bench, vide its Order dated 20-06-2022..Public holding will be thus 5.12 % of the New capital of 5,26,97,106 nos. of shares of Rs 10 each.   Thus effect of reduction of share capital and allotment of new shares to the Promoters of the Company have made in the September 2022 quarter onwards.  Therefore, the same is not having any effect on SHP of June, 2022 Quarter.
